data.summary: Overall experience of 8 years out of which 6 yrs. in to Business Analyst role in Wealth Management & Insurance domain with a proven track record in delivering projects across SDLC methodologies - Agile and Waterfall.

domain_and_functional: Policy Sourcing KYC, AML (Digital & CRM Channels)
all_skills: Policy Sourcing KYC, AML (Digital & CRM Channels)

responsibilities: Collaborate with business stakeholders, product owners, and cross-functional teams to gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements for multiple strategic initiatives.
Worked on Data Migration projects, ensuring accurate mapping, validation, reconciliation, and smooth transition of data between legacy and target systems.
Contributed to Financial Planning projects by analyzing business processes, identifying gaps, and supporting implementation of process improvements and system enhancements.

Played a key role in Digital Transformation initiatives, including enhancements to an existing wealth management application to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business workflows.
Conduct requirement elicitation sessions, workshops, and stakeholder discussions to define project scope, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
Prepare and maintain documentation such as BRDs, FRDs, user stories, process flows, gap analysis, and functional specifications.
Work closely with development, QA, and product teams throughout the SDLC to ensure successful delivery of business requirements.
Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives using Agile and Scrum methodologies.
Support UAT activities by coordinating testing efforts, validating business scenarios, and ensuring defect resolution aligns with business expectations.
Track project progress, manage stakeholder communication, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones.
Utilize tools such as Jira and Confluence for requirement management, sprint tracking, and project documentation.
Collaborate with technical and business teams to identify process optimization opportunities and recommend scalable business solutions.

Sr. Business Analyst in Wealth Management Projects for feature Enhancements in areas like Mutual funds financial & Non-financial transactions in Investment Services Account (ISA). Implementation of onboarding platform for ISA A/c’s.
Worked in Agile under scrum framework for Digital Transformation Project for enhancement of various features in Wealth Management Services platform.
Gathering the requirements & splitting them into User stories with defined acceptance criteria before starting to work with Technical Teams like Design, Development & Quality Analysis.
Taking the ownership of Product Backlog, continuously grooming the backlog & prioritizing the requirements in the backlog.
Contributed in all scrum ceremonies like Sprint planning, Daily standup, Sprint review, Retrospective, Backlog grooming Sessions.
Conducted meetings with technical team to give a walk through on requirements before implementation & Testing them.
Monitoring, reporting of ongoing, upcoming features, open issues to management on a timely basis.
Handled bugs as part of production support as well along with delivery of the new features.
Prioritized the requirements in backlog based on business demands, highest business value being added to the product.
Coordinated with UI Designer Teams for getting required prototype before Development initiation.
Assisted QA teams in preparing Test Cases and participated in functional Testing along with QA.
Coordinated with Project stakeholders throughout the project life cycle till functionality go live.
Demonstrated the developed functionalities to Business teams through PPT presentations.
Continuous Engagement with Business teams for taking new requirements & giving updates on ongoing work, upcoming releases, challenges, open issues etc.
Collaborated with Scrum master to review reports like burn up, burn down charts, velocity reports and discussed strategies to improve productivity.

Business Analyst for Different Wealth Management Projects in Investment Advisory Services, Mutual Funds Service Portal, Insurance Digital Journeys – Policy Origination, Administration Services (Servicing).
Stakeholder Management and Requirement gathering. Conducted AS-IS and TO-BE Analysis and suggest Fit for Business Solutions by designing a Change Strategy.
Organize & Lead Requirement Gathering (Elicitation) meetings using techniques like Interviews, Questionnaires, Document Analysis, Brainstorming Sessions and Focus Group Discussions
Evaluated change requests by impact analysis of triple constraints – time, cost, scope.
preparing BRD, FRD, user stories, information architecture and demo story boards.
Performing gap analysis between the developed features and the nuances in the industry.
Elicitation Techniques, Effective Usage of Tools and Techniques, Maintaining Product Backlog and prioritizing features. Review test cases created by QA team & Conducting UAT.
Successfully participated in various Scrum Ceremonies by sharing opinions on process & product innovation. Product feature enhancements recommendations on quality.
Sale Development Manager – Sales Strategy and Forecasting, Client Relationship Management, CRM & Pipeline Management & Market research and Analysis.
Enhanced profitability by developing pipelines utilizing marketing and sales methods
Created and implemented new business opportunities by utilizing strategic networking strategies.
Communicate product quality and market comparisons by creating sales strategies.
Maintained up-to-date knowledge of competitor products and pricing in market served.
Built relationships with customers and community to establish long-term business growth.
Encouraged cross-selling of additional products and services through relationship-building and acquired understanding of customer business needs.
